_comment: Proposed answers for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, derived from evidence in this repository. Only criteria backed by a file or setting are listed; everything else is left for the maintainers to answer. Format: https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/bestpractices-json.md
contribution_justification: The contribution process, including pull requests, is described in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
dependency_monitoring_justification: Composer Audit checks the dependencies against known vulnerabilities in CI and fails the job on any advisory it finds that composer.json does not exempt (1 advisory is exempted under config.audit.ignore: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/composer.json), so a vulnerable dependency has to be upgraded or explicitly handled before a change passes. Only when all three attempts fail with a download or timeout error from the advisory source does the job pass, with a visible warning that no audit took place; any other failure fails it at once: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/.github/workflows/checks.yml (shared workflow: https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml).
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable, addressable by URL and need no proprietary client: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/issues
floss_license_justification: Released under GPL-3.0-or-later, an OSI-approved licence: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/LICENSE. The grant GPL-3.0-or-later is stated in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/composer.json; LICENSE holds the licence text.
license_location_justification: The licence file is in the repository root: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/LICENSE
release_notes_justification: Human-readable release notes per version are kept in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md; it covers the latest release, v3.6.9.
repo_distributed_justification: The repository uses git, hosted at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter
repo_public_justification: The source repository is public on GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter
repo_track_justification: Git records the author, date and change of every commit; the history is browsable at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/commits/main
report_archive_justification: Public bug reports and the responses to them stay searchable in the issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/issues
sites_https_justification: Every project site is served over HTTPS: the repository and its release downloads, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter; the Composer package, https://packagist.org/packages/netresearch/t3-cowriter; the TYPO3 Extension Repository entry, https://extensions.typo3.org/extension/t3_cowriter.
static_analysis_justification: PHPStan runs on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI where PHPStan is on by default (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml). Configuration: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/Build/phpstan.neon.
test_justification: The repository carries 27 PHPUnit test files under https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/tree/main/Tests (2 e2e, 5 integration, 20 unit). CI runs the unit suite on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) with its unit-test job (on by default). The integration and e2e suites run on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/.github/workflows/testing.yml, which calls the shared extended testing (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/extended-testing.yml) with `run-integration-tests: true` and `run-e2e-tests: true`. With its defaults, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/.github/workflows/testing.yml also runs the PHPUnit fuzz group, the JavaScript tests and an Infection mutation run.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs the unit suite on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) with its unit-test job (on by default). The integration and e2e suites run on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/.github/workflows/testing.yml, which calls the shared extended testing (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/extended-testing.yml) with `run-integration-tests: true` and `run-e2e-tests: true`. With its defaults, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/.github/workflows/testing.yml also runs the PHPUnit fuzz group, the JavaScript tests and an Infection mutation run.
version_semver_justification: Releases follow Semantic Versioning, for example v3.6.8: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/tags
version_tags_justification: Every release is tagged in git: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/tags
version_unique_justification: Each release has its own version number, recorded as a git tag, for example v3.6.8: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/tags
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, described in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/SECURITY.md: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/security/advisories/new (the repository setting is enabled, as the GitHub API reports for GET /repos/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/private-vulnerability-reporting)
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability reporting process is published in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-cowriter/blob/main/SECURITY.md
